generations.prompt: Naturalistic footage of an ancient Mediterranean harbor town in late autumn. Overcast winter light, muted colors, soft contrast, real textures, nothing staged. Dusk on a steep narrow lane of worn stone steps between plastered stone houses on a hillside. The lane is empty at first. A man in his mid-forties with cropped hair, a short dark beard going grey and a belted undyed wool tunic walks into the frame from the bottom edge, close to the lens and large at first, his back to the camera, carrying on his right shoulder a long wooden steering oar about three meters long with a broad flat blade and a short crosswise handle at the top, the blade pointing up behind him. He climbs the lane slowly away from the camera. A white domestic goose waddles across the lane in front of him from one side to the other; he pauses, steps around it, and walks on up the hill. He never turns toward the camera. Camera is fixed, no camera movement. No music, no speech. No on-screen text, no captions, no watermark.
